'''Ana Denicola''' (born 30 September 1959) is an Uruguayan pharmacist, chemical researcher and professor in the [[Faculty of Science (University of the Uruguayan Republic)|science faculty]] at the [[University of the Republic (Uruguay)|University of the Uruguayan Republic]], from 2005 to 2010 she was head of the faculty there. She is a Grade 5 teacher at that faculty and she also works as a first-level researcher in the Basic Sciences Developmental Program (PEDECIBA) and the National Research System of the Uruguayan Agency of Research and Innovation, SNI level III.<ref name=IANAS>{{cite web|title=Ana Denicola|url=http://www.ianas.org/index.php/members/78-ianas/491-ana-denicola|website=ianas.org|publisher=Inter-American Network of Academics of Sciences|access-date=17 November 2017|archive-date=17 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171117123016/http://www.ianas.org/index.php/members/78-ianas/491-ana-denicola|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=November 15, 2023 |title=Ceibal Training |url=https://blogs.ceibal.edu.uy/formacion/dra-ana-denicola/}}</ref> From 2000 to 2002, Denicola was president of the Uruguayan Society for the [[Biosciences]] and she is a full member of the National Academy of Sciences of Uruguay.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academia Nacional de Ciencias del Uruguay |url=https://anciu.org.uy/ |access-date=2023-11-16 |website=anciu.org.uy}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Denicola possesses a [[master's degree]] in [[chemistry]] from the University of the Uruguayan Republic and a Ph.D. in [[biochemistry]] from [[Virginia Tech]] in 1989.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ana DENICOLA CRECI|url=https://buscadores.anii.org.uy/buscador_sni/exportador/ExportarPdf?hash=2f671fd4dd4d744a32c9f1792443d5bb|website=buscadores.anii.org.uy|publisher=Sistema Nacional de Investigadores|access-date=17 November 2017}}</ref> Her field of research is the characterization of kinetic and [[physicochemical]] [[free radical]]s produced [[in vivo]],<ref name="IANAS" /> particularly in [[oxygen]] and [[nitrogen]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Ana Denicola|url=http://iqb.fcien.edu.uy/docentes/anad.html|website=iqb.fcien.edu.uy|publisher=Instituto de Quimíca Biológica|access-date=17 November 2017|language=es}}</ref> She has over 60 published articles.<ref name="IANAS" /> Currently, she is a research director at the University of the Uruguayan Republic.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ana Denicola|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Ana_Denicola|website=researchgate.net|access-date=17 November 2017}}</ref>

== Awards ==
In 2009, she received the [[L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Awards|L’Oréal-UNESCO Prize “Women and Science]]” for her contributions to scientific development in Uruguay.<ref>{{Cite web |last=historico.espectador.com |date=2009-11-11 |title=L´ORÉAL y UNESCO entregaron el premio "Por las Mujeres en la Ciencia" en Uruguay |url=http://historico.espectador.com/economia/166739/l-oreal-y-unesco-entregaron-el-premio-por-las-mujeres-en-la-ciencia-en-uruguay |access-date=2023-11-16 |website=HISTORICO.ESPECTADOR.COM |language=es}}</ref>

In 2014, she received the Morosoli de Plata award in the area of Science and Technology.{{Citation needed|date=December 2023}}
